claims: Normal alkaline batteries are designed for single use and cannot be recharged.
Attempting to recharge alkaline batteries can cause them to leak, overheat, or rupture.
Always use rechargeable batteries like NiMH if you need to recharge them.

claims.text: Attempts to recharge standard alkaline batteries may cause rupture, or the leaking of hazardous liquids that corrode the equipment.
It is reported that standard alkaline batteries can often be recharged a few times, but with reduced capacity after each charge.
